Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent PAGASA forecasts project a daily maximum of 32°C in Manila on June 2 under partly cloudy to cloudy skies with a 60% rain chance, consistent with the onset of the southwest monsoon and near-normal early-June conditions. This aligns with climatological averages of 32°C highs during the transition from the hot dry season, where increasing humidity and scattered showers typically moderate peak temperatures. Model consensus and historical data place most outcomes near 31–32°C, with traders assigning 74% combined probability to those thresholds amid typical forecast uncertainty ranges for tropical urban heat. Updated agency guidance and any late-developing convective activity remain the key near-term variables.
